recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞比例高，可見晚期紅母細胞核出現分葉、出芽及輪廓不規則，並有一個核形不規則、疑似晚期有絲分裂的細胞，屬於明顯的紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Erythroid precursors at all stages, from basophilic proerythroblast to orthochromatic normoblasts
Late erythroblast with multilobated (cloverleaf-like) nucleus, consistent with nuclear budding/irregularity
Erythroid precursor with dense, irregularly contoured nucleus suggestive of an abnormal late mitosis
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: clumped nuclei with still-polychromatic cytoplasm
Several large disrupted/bare nuclei (smudged cells) in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows prominent erythroid precursors spanning all stages of maturation. Several late erythroblasts show nuclear lobulation, budding and irregular contours, and one cell has a dense irregular nucleus suggestive of an abnormal late mitotic figure. Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony is present. Scattered disrupted bare nuclei are seen in the background. These dyserythropoietic changes support a myelodysplastic neoplasm; the blast percentage (not assessable from this field) determines the subtype, here reported as MDS with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows uniformly open, sieve-like chromatin with giant bands and hypersegmented neutrophils, and resolves with vitamin replacement.
CDA is a lifelong isolated erythroid disorder without increased blasts or dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: Toxic / reactive dyserythropoiesis (alcohol, chemotherapy, arsenic, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Clinical history, nutritional studies and absence of clonal cytogenetic abnormalities favor a reactive cause.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, far more primitive cells than seen here.
